jobDescription:
Pinnacle Financial Services is searching for a Director of Engineering to lead our platform engineering organization. You will manage multiple engineering managers, own the technical strategy for our core infrastructure, and partner with the VP of Engineering and CPO to shape product direction.

Responsibilities:
- Lead 3-4 engineering managers and an organization of 25-35 engineers
- Define and execute multi-year technical roadmap for platform and infrastructure
- Drive organization-wide engineering culture, hiring strategy, and performance management
- Partner with product, design, and data science to deliver strategic company initiatives
- Own reliability, scalability, and security posture for all engineering systems
- Represent engineering in executive leadership discussions and board-level presentations

Requirements:
- 10+ years of engineering experience with at least 3 years in people management
- Demonstrated track record of managing engineering managers (manager-of-managers experience)
- Deep technical background in distributed systems or cloud infrastructure
- Experience managing teams through significant organizational or technical transformation
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate technical trade-offs to non-technical executives
- Experience in fintech or regulated industries preferred

Nice to have:
- Experience scaling engineering teams from 10 to 50+
- Background in cloud cost optimization and infrastructure cost governance
- Familiarity with SOC 2 compliance and security engineering practices
